answer.text: Only by converting NRE to resident

explanation.text: The Logic: NRIs can invest in PMS through NRE/NRO routes and RBI-approved PMS providers. The Trap: PIS approval is not required for PMS investments; PMS access is not limited to Category I AIFs and does not require conversion of NRE to resident. Note: NRI PMS subscriptions are routed through NRE/NRO accounts and an RBI-approved PMS provider.
